PSRR at 1 kHz is 39.2 dB, just under the 40 dB spec. All other specs pass at tt/27 °C. PSRR at 1 kHz is set by loop gain, which scales with gm_in/Cc. So I'll raise the tail current and lower Cc, paying for it with the remaining quiescent-current headroom (59 µA used of 69 µA).

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "PSRR at 1 kHz misses by 0.8 dB and depends on loop gain (~gm_in/Cc). Raise I_tail/gmid_in and lower Cc, using ~10 uA of spare Iq. Keep I_bleed and Rz in range so ringing (7.3 mV, limit 10 mV) and phase margin hold. Then check all 45 PVT conditions.",
 "params": {"I_tail": 7e-6, "gmid_in": 18.0, "Cc": 14e-12, "Rz": 8e3, "I_bleed": 38e-6},
 "bounds": {"I_tail": [4e-6, 10e-6], "Cc": [8e-12, 24e-12], "gmid_in": [14.0, 22.0], "I_bleed": [28e-6, 45e-6], "Rz": [3e3, 20e3]}}
```
